title: Framer footer
description: A quiet black link footer: six columns of small groups (white group titles, grey links that turn white on hover, tiny "new" tags), two columns on phones, then one low row with the mark, a language picker, social icons, compliance badges, a blue-ticked status line and the copyright.
notes: columns hold groups; on phones the groups re-flow into two balanced columns
social icons come in as nodes (the demo uses @tabler/icons-react)
